recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. The current source satisfies FHIR-5713 after later same-family refinements; future planned or waitlisted appointment semantics should be handled under dedicated later trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-5713 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and requested a new Appointment.status code "proposed" because "pending" represented a later lifecycle state. The resolution directed adding proposed, updating usage notes, and adding invariants to handle optional start/end date-times.
initial_application: Historical commit 44a2cf49ea added proposed status support, changed Appointment.start and Appointment.end to 0..1, added app-2/app-3 invariants, and updated usage notes. Commit 8db2dceb19 later corrected app-3 for the same Appointment change family so proposed/cancelled appointments could omit start/end.
additional_context: FHIR-5702 requested a proposed Encounter status but was closed no-change, supporting use of Appointment for this planning state. FHIR-6938 relied on FHIR-5713's proposed status for planned unscheduled encounters. FHIR-18824 later added waitlist as another status allowed to omit start/end.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Appointment is in current build scope, proposed is present in the status CodeSystem and Appointment.status short text, current notes and examples show proposed appointment requests, and app-3/start/end cardinalities still support appointments whose date-times are not yet known.

related_jiras.note: Proposed Encounter was discussed but closed no-change, supporting use of Appointment rather than adding an Encounter status here.
FHIR-6938 explicitly relied on the proposed Appointment status and optional start/end behavior to cover unscheduled planned encounters.
Later added waitlist as another Appointment status allowed to omit start/end, explaining the current app-3 wording beyond FHIR-5713's original scope.
